title: Among female patients aged 40 or older with abnormal uric acid levels (defi
question: Among female patients aged 40 or older with abnormal uric acid levels (defined per original evidence as UA <= 6.5), find the one with the highest total cholesterol. Return her patient ID and admission status.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", T2."XCL_013"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")) >= 40
  AND T3."XCL_022" <= 6.5
ORDER BY T3."XCL_026" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_058", T1."XCL_064"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
